title: Feature Request: Manual Autosense reset action
body:
By following example scenario:
- A child eats some carbs without entering it in AAPS - AAPS reacts by increasing temporary Basal rate but also Autosense goes up after some time.

I would wish to have a possibility to manually reset the Autosense state back to 100% based on the recognized mistake of the user.

comments.body: easiest way is to do new profile switch (without duration)
